name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2025-05-10, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 3.60 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
